name: Age dependency ratio, young (% of working-age population)
sourceNote: Age dependency ratio, young, is the ratio of younger dependents--people younger than 15--to the working-age population--those ages 15-64. Data are shown as the proportion of dependents per 100 working-age population.
sourceOrganization:
World Population Prospects, United Nations (UN), publisher: UN Population Division;
Staff estimates, World Bank (WB)
